image_description: A sepia-toned close-up portrait of a young woman with long hair, holding a large woodwind instrument vertically next to her face. The instrument features a dark wooden body with complex silver metal keywork and rods running parallel to the tube. Only a section of the instrument is visible, primarily the lower joint or boot area, not the full length or bell.

Some of the smaller connecting rods and key levers appear to merge slightly or lack clear mechanical separation points upon close inspection, though generally plausible.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of woodwind instrument given the partial view.
To verify the mechanical connectivity of the complex metal keys and ensure no floating elements.
To assess overall coherence, lighting consistency, and subtle texture artifacts in the skin and wood.

focus_areas: Mechanical plausibility of the visible keywork

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the mechanical logic of the bassoon keys. AI often fails to render the intricate linkage of rods and levers correctly, resulting in 'melted' or non-functional mechanisms. Verify if the visible keys connect logically to the tone holes.
